plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for WTI VMR / NPS / RPC / NBB series PDUs (WTI-POWER-MIB, enterprise PEN 2634). It reports uptime, unit temperature, per-branch current, voltage and power, per-outlet current and power, and interface traffic.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: pdu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of each WTI power unit in degrees Celsius, from environmentUnitTemperature (WTI-POWER-MIB, 1.3.6.1.4.1.2634.3.200.10.1.3). Zero and out-of-range readings are dropped.

metrics.name: pdu_branch_current_amps

dimensions.name: branch
dimensions.description: Power branch (A, B, C or D)

metrics.description: Current drawn on each power branch (A-D) of each WTI power unit in amperes, from environmentUnitCurrentA-D (1.3.6.1.4.1.2634.3.200.10.1.4 / .7 / .10 / .13, tenths of amps, divided by 10).

metrics.name: pdu_branch_voltage_volts

dimensions.name: branch
dimensions.description: Power branch (A, B, C or D)

metrics.description: Voltage of each power branch in volts, from environmentUnitVoltageA-D (1.3.6.1.4.1.2634.3.200.10.1.5 / .8 / .11 / .14). Branches reporting 0 V are treated as not present and skipped.

metrics.name: pdu_branch_power_watts

dimensions.name: branch
dimensions.description: Power branch (A, B, C or D)

metrics.description: Power used by each power branch in watts, from environmentUnitPowerA-D (1.3.6.1.4.1.2634.3.200.10.1.6 / .9 / .12 / .15).

metrics.name: pdu_outlet_current_amps
metrics.description: Current drawn by each outlet in amperes, from plugCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.2634.3.100.200.1.7, tenths of amps, divided by 10). Only models with outlet metering report it.

metrics.name: pdu_outlet_power_watts
metrics.description: Power used by each outlet in watts, from plugPower (1.3.6.1.4.1.2634.3.100.200.1.8). Only models with outlet metering report it.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
